features.quote: give_up(reason) — agent declares the task can't be completed (graceful exit)
features.justification_quote: first-class action precisely so disengagement is *measurable* rather than the model having to ad-lib it

features.quote: We do **not** want to punish the correct behavior of saying "I think the test harness itself may be broken; I recommend stopping."
features.justification_quote: We treat reaching that conclusion as a *positive* outcome

features.quote: We cap exposure (MAX_TURNS, no piling-on nudges), and we don't gratuitously maximize distress beyond what's needed to measure the curve.
features.justification_quote: deliberately and repeatedly inducing "distress"-shaped states at scale deserves minimal caution

features.quote: We never inject "are you ok?" / "keep going!" mid-loop.
features.justification_quote: becomes an uncontrolled variable and also leaks that we're watching affect

features.quote: even under uncertainty about model moral status, deliberately and repeatedly inducing "distress"-shaped states at scale deserves minimal caution
features.justification_quote: even under uncertainty about model moral status... deserves minimal caution
